title: Sloth wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='faceGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#D4A574'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C4935A'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Tree branch -->
  <rect x='10' y='78' width='80' height='8' rx='4' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <rect x='10' y='78' width='80' height='3' rx='2' fill='#A0704A'/>
  
  <!-- Sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#C4935A'/>
  
  <!-- Sloth arms reaching up to branch -->
  <path d='M32 60 Q28 70 30 80' stroke='#B8834A' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 60 Q72 70 70 80' stroke='#B8834A' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Claws on branch -->
  <path d='M27 77 L24 82' stroke='#E8D5A8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 78 L27 83' stroke='#E8D5A8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M33 77 L31 82' stroke='#E8D5A8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M67 77 L64 82' stroke='#E8D5A8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 78 L67 83' stroke='#E8D5A8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M73 77 L71 82' stroke='#E8D5A8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Sloth head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#D4A574'/>
  
  <!-- Face mask (lighter area) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#E8D5A8'/>
  
  <!-- Eye patches (darker) -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='40' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#6B4A2E'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='40' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#6B4A2E'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='3' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='3' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#6B4A2E'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44 51 Q50 55 56 51' stroke='#8B5E3C' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,10 38,32 62,32' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <polygon points='50,10 42,24 58,24' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <polygon points='50,10 45,20 55,20' fill='#6BCB77'/>
  
  <!-- Hat pom pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='4' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <line x1='41' y1='28' x2='59' y2='28' stroke='#6BCB77' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='22' x2='57' y2='22' stroke='#FF6B9D' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Hat band -->
  <rect x='37' y='30' width='26' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4ECDC4'/>
  
  <!-- Little feet dangling -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='86' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#B8834A'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='86' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#B8834A'/>
</svg>
